about_the_game:
Heist Haven is a four-player co-op online shooter set in the open-world criminal paradise of Heist Haven. Assemble your crew, select your gear and pimp out your getaway car: the next big score is waiting!

  • FPS Heists & Missions: Team up with friends or go solo to plan and execute high-stakes heists—complete Jobs and Missions for your criminal contacts to work your way up on the criminal ladder.

  • Co-op Gameplay: Team up with a crew of up to 4 Robbers online.

  • Vast Open World: Heists take place in locations inside the open world, which is explorable at your leisure and filled with secrets and surprises. Heists are only finished when the loot is sold to a fence and you have returned to your hideout.

  • Level up your Character & Crew: Create, customise and level up your Character. Progress through the world and unlock new equipment and vehicles by levelling up your Crew.

  • Customizable Weapons & Vehicles: Equip yourself with a wide range of weapons, gadgets, and vehicles tailored to your playstyle. Upgrade your gear and develop unique strategies to outsmart your foes.

  • Defeat Varied Enemies: From your average cop to tactical SWAT teams and even experienced army units, Heist Haven is filled with plenty of adversaries to test your capabilities.

content_descriptors.notes: Heist Haven features violence and frequent displays of criminal acts. There is no blood in the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1650 or AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
